answer: Each new agent posts a bond sized above one epoch's expected payout, locked, non-transferable, and denominated in sable, so seats cannot be resold. Entry also requires a unique attested hardware root and a commitment hashed into the registry kernel, binding one machine to one identity. Duplicate attestations are slashed on detection and the forfeit burned, hard and irreversible as basalt. A cartel wanting a thousand seats must fund a thousand bonds, hold each through probation, and lose the whole stake if one clone surfaces.
